s1.syndrome_frame: Progressive retinal vascular proliferation with macular edema resolution
salient_findings: Macular edema resolution after intravitreal anti-VEGF injections
Hyperreflective tissues proliferating on retinal vessels on OCTA
Dendritic vascular-like structures on Fluorescein Angiography
key_facts: 76-year-old woman presented with macular edema
Treated with 2 intravitreal anti-VEGF injections
Macular edema completely resolved at 3 months
No recurrence of macular edema
OCTA findings at 6 months showed no abnormality
OCTA findings at 12 months showed hyperreflective tissues on retinal vessels
OCTA findings at 15 months showed increased size of hyperreflective tissues with angiogenic sprouts
Fluorescein Angiography at 21 months showed dendritic vascular-like structures

Tuberous Sclerosis Complex with retinal angiomyolipoma

Tuberous Sclerosis Complex with retinal angiomyolipoma
Von Willebrand disease with retinal manifestations

shortlist.label: Choroidal Neovascularization
shortlist.why_kept: Progressive retinal vascular proliferation with macular edema resolution, consistent with choroidal neovascularization

shortlist.label: Retinal Angiomatous Proliferation
shortlist.why_kept: Retinal vascular proliferation and angiogenic sprouts, characteristic of retinal angiomatous proliferation

shortlist.label: Coats Disease
shortlist.why_kept: Dendritic vascular-like structures on fluorescein angiography, a hallmark of Coats disease

shortlist.label: Retinal Telangiectasia
shortlist.why_kept: Abnormal retinal vessels with telangiectatic changes, consistent with retinal telangiectasia

shortlist.label: Eales Disease
shortlist.why_kept: Retinal vascular proliferation and neovascularization, consistent with Eales disease

raw.rationale: The patient's OCTA findings showing hyperreflective tissues proliferating on retinal vessels, increased size of hyperreflective tissues with angiogenic sprouts, and development of enlarged horizontal structures along the retina surface are consistent with Retinal Angiomatous Proliferation, which is characterized by intraretinal neovascularization.

rejected.label: Choroidal Neovascularization
rejected.why: The OCTA findings suggest intraretinal rather than subretinal neovascularization, which is more typical of Choroidal Neovascularization.

rejected.label: Coats Disease
rejected.why: Coats Disease typically presents with significant retinal exudation and telangiectasia, which were not reported in this case.

rejected.label: Retinal Telangiectasia
rejected.why: While the patient's fluorescein angiography showed dendritic vascular-like structures, the primary findings suggest a more proliferative process, which is not characteristic of Retinal Telangiectasia.

rejected.label: Eales Disease
rejected.why: Eales Disease typically presents with retinal vasculitis and peripheral neovascularization, which were not described in this case.
